domain_impact.conclusion: The B2 drop is not a real universe contraction. A backfill would raise B2 back to roughly the pre-seam level, which is why the HALT floor of 500 names never bound and why cross-seam comparisons of domain SIZE are invalid.

coverage_gap.not_yet_fixed: The codes are still missing from the panel; this round diagnoses, it does not backfill.

ownership_evidence.interpretation: Zero loss in every Shanghai prefix and a 74% loss in sz.000 is not a property of the market; it is a property of the fetch.

coverage_gap.retracted_claim: Earlier notes said the 561 missing codes were mostly suspended or delisted. That is false: 558 of 561 have complete upstream bars, and their market-cap percentiles are uniform across all ten deciles, which is the signature of a fetch artefact rather than of genuine exits.

horizon_sensitivity.reading: IC does not decay from 20 to 40 days; it rises slightly. Sharing a common entry date across horizons, a 40-day return contains the 20-day return, so the two are mechanically related and the comparison is a persistence statement, not an independence test.

attribution.explanation: Absolute churn rose only 6.3% while the tail shrank 14.6%, so the rate ratio 1.245 = 1.063 / 0.854. The rate looks alarming because the denominator moved, not because the scorer became unstable.

turnover_reconciliation.headline: The forward 0.5267 previously reported and the C-track 0.3805 are NOT the same quantity. 0.5267 is the membership KEEP rate; the C-track reports the CHANGE rate. Like-for-like, forward change rate is 0.4733.
